<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';

	interface Ball {
		x: number;
		y: number;
		vx: number;
		vy: number;
		radius: number;
	}

	interface Props {
		element?: HTMLCanvasElement;
		ballCount: number;
		isPaused: boolean;
		onFrameUpdate: (count: number) => void;
	}

	let { element = $bindable(), ballCount = 5, isPaused = false, onFrameUpdate } = $props();

	const CANVAS_WIDTH = 400;
	const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 300;
	const BALL_RADIUS = 10;
	const GRAVITY = 0.2;

	let balls = $state<Ball[]>([]);
	let frameCount = $state(0);
	let animationId: number | null = null;
	let ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D | null = null;

	function createBalls(count: number): Ball[] {
		const newBalls: Ball[] = [];
		for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
			newBalls.push({
				x: Math.random() * (CANVAS_WIDTH - 2 * BALL_RADIUS) + BALL_RADIUS,
				y: Math.random() * (CANVAS_HEIGHT - 2 * BALL_RADIUS) + BALL_RADIUS,
				vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
				vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
				radius: BALL_RADIUS
			});
		}
		return newBalls;
	}

	function updateBalls() {
		// Apply gravity
		for (const ball of balls) {
			ball.vy += GRAVITY;
		}

		// Update positions
		for (const ball of balls) {
			ball.x += ball.vx;
			ball.y += ball.vy;
		}

		// Handle collisions with walls
		for (const ball of balls) {
			// Left and right walls
			if (ball.x - ball.radius < 0) {
				ball.x = ball.radius;
				ball.vx = -ball.vx;
			}
			if (ball.x + ball.radius > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
				ball.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - ball.radius;
				ball.vx = -ball.vx;
			}

			// Top and bottom walls
			if (ball.y - ball.radius < 0) {
				ball.y = ball.radius;
				ball.vy = -ball.vy;
			}
			if (ball.y + ball.radius > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
				ball.y = CANVAS_HEIGHT - ball.radius;
				ball.vy = -ball.vy;
			}
		}

		// Handle ball-to-ball collisions (elastic collision - exchange velocities)
		for (let i = 0; i < balls.length; i++) {
			for (let j = i + 1; j < balls.length; j++) {
				const ball1 = balls[i];
				const ball2 = balls[j];

				const dx = ball2.x - ball1.x;
				const dy = ball2.y - ball1.y;
				const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
				const minDistance = ball1.radius + ball2.radius;

				if (distance < minDistance) {
					// Exchange velocities for elastic collision
					const tempVx = ball1.vx;
					const tempVy = ball1.vy;
					ball1.vx = ball2.vx;
					ball1.vy = ball2.vy;
					ball2.vx = tempVx;
					ball2.vy = tempVy;

					// Separate balls to avoid overlap
					const overlap = minDistance - distance;
					const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
					const moveX = (overlap / 2) * Math.cos(angle);
					const moveY = (overlap / 2) * Math.sin(angle);

					ball1.x -= moveX;
					ball1.y -= moveY;
					ball2.x += moveX;
					ball2.y += moveY;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	function draw() {
		if (!ctx) return;

		// Clear canvas
		ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
		ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

		// Draw border
		ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
		ctx.lineWidth = 2;
		ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

		// Draw balls
		for (const ball of balls) {
			ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${Math.random() * 360}, 100%, 50%)`;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
		}
	}

	function animate() {
		if (!isPaused) {
			updateBalls();
			draw();
			frameCount++;
			onFrameUpdate(frameCount);
		}

		animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
	}

	function resetSimulation() {
		balls = createBalls(ballCount);
		frameCount = 0;
		onFrameUpdate(0);
	}

	$effect(() => {
		if (element && !ctx) {
			ctx = element.getContext('2d');
			resetSimulation();
			animate();
		}
	});

	$effect(() => {
		if (ballCount > balls.length) {
			const newCount = ballCount - balls.length;
			for (let i = 0; i < newCount; i++) {
				balls.push({
					x: Math.random() * (CANVAS_WIDTH - 2 * BALL_RADIUS) + BALL_RADIUS,
					y: Math.random() * (CANVAS_HEIGHT - 2 * BALL_RADIUS) + BALL_RADIUS,
					vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
					vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
					radius: BALL_RADIUS
				});
			}
			balls = balls;
		}
	});

	$effect(() => {
		if (frameCount === 0 && ballCount === 5) {
			resetSimulation();
		}
	});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, defineEmits, defineExpose } from 'vue'

interface Ball {
  x: number
  y: number
  vx: number
  vy: number
  radius: number
}

const emit = defineEmits<{
  ballCountChange: [count: number]
  frameCountChange: [count: number]
}>()

const GRAVITY = 0.2
const RADIUS = 10
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 400
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 300

const balls = ref<Ball[]>([])
const frameCount = ref(0)
let animationId: number | null = null
const isPaused = ref(false)
const canvas = ref<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null)

const createRandomBall = (): Ball => {
  return {
    x: Math.random() * (CANVAS_WIDTH - 2 * RADIUS) + RADIUS,
    y: Math.random() * (CANVAS_HEIGHT - 2 * RADIUS) + RADIUS,
    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
    vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
    radius: RADIUS,
  }
}

const initializeBalls = () => {
  balls.value = Array.from({ length: 5 }, () => createRandomBall())
  frameCount.value = 0
  emit('ballCountChange', balls.value.length)
  emit('frameCountChange', frameCount.value)
}

const addBall = () => {
  balls.value.push(createRandomBall())
  emit('ballCountChange', balls.value.length)
}

const setPaused = (paused: boolean) => {
  isPaused.value = paused
}

const restart = () => {
  isPaused.value = false
  initializeBalls()
}

const checkCollisionAndReact = (ball1: Ball, ball2: Ball) => {
  const dx = ball2.x - ball1.x
  const dy = ball2.y - ball1.y
  const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
  const minDistance = ball1.radius + ball2.radius

  if (distance < minDistance) {
    // Elastic collision: swap velocities
    const tempVx = ball1.vx
    const tempVy = ball1.vy
    ball1.vx = ball2.vx
    ball1.vy = ball2.vy
    ball2.vx = tempVx
    ball2.vy = tempVy

    // Separate balls to prevent overlap
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx)
    const overlap = minDistance - distance
    const moveDistance = overlap / 2 + 1
    ball1.x -= Math.cos(angle) * moveDistance
    ball1.y -= Math.sin(angle) * moveDistance
    ball2.x += Math.cos(angle) * moveDistance
    ball2.y += Math.sin(angle) * moveDistance
  }
}

const updatePhysics = () => {
  for (const ball of balls.value) {
    // Apply gravity
    ball.vy += GRAVITY

    // Update position
    ball.x += ball.vx
    ball.y += ball.vy

    // Bounce off walls
    if (ball.x - ball.radius < 0) {
      ball.x = ball.radius
      ball.vx = -ball.vx
    }
    if (ball.x + ball.radius > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
      ball.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - ball.radius
      ball.vx = -ball.vx
    }
    if (ball.y - ball.radius < 0) {
      ball.y = ball.radius
      ball.vy = -ball.vy
    }
    if (ball.y + ball.radius > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
      ball.y = CANVAS_HEIGHT - ball.radius
      ball.vy = -ball.vy
    }
  }

  // Check collisions between balls
  for (let i = 0; i < balls.value.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < balls.value.length; j++) {
      checkCollisionAndReact(balls.value[i], balls.value[j])
    }
  }
}

const draw = () => {
  if (!canvas.value) return

  const ctx = canvas.value.getContext('2d')
  if (!ctx) return

  // Clear canvas
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000'
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT)

  // Draw balls
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FF6B6B'
  for (const ball of balls.value) {
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2)
    ctx.fill()
  }
}

const animate = () => {
  if (!isPaused.value) {
    updatePhysics()
    frameCount.value++
    emit('frameCountChange', frameCount.value)
  }

  draw()
  animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animate)
}

onMounted(() => {
  canvas.value = document.getElementById('sim') as HTMLCanvasElement
  initializeBalls()
  animate()
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  if (animationId !== null) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(animationId)
  }
})

defineExpose({
  addBall,
  setPaused,
  restart,
})
</script>
